promotionDetail.title: Vibrant Summer Getaway Package
promotionDetail.description: Enjoy a 20% discount on all rooms for stays of 3 nights or more, including free breakfast and a spa voucher.
promotionDetail.full_description:
Enjoy a vibrant summer vacation at our hotel with this special offer package. The package includes: 3 nights in a Deluxe room with a city or sea view, daily buffet breakfast at the restaurant, one 500,000 VND voucher for spa services at The Serene Spa, and free access to the infinity pool.

Applicable for bookings and stays from June 1, 2025, to August 31, 2025. Cannot be combined with other promotions. A 7-day advance booking is required. Contact reception for more details on other terms and conditions.

promotionDetail.title: Ultimate Spa & Dining Experience
promotionDetail.description: Relax with a premium spa treatment and enjoy a romantic dinner at our restaurant.
promotionDetail.full_description:
The Spa & Dining package is the perfect combination for a romantic evening. The package includes: one 60-minute full-body massage at The Serene Spa, and a premium set menu dinner for two at our rooftop restaurant with panoramic views of the sea and city.

Applicable for couples and requires at least 24 hours advance booking. Valid for use until December 31, 2025. Please contact us to schedule your spa appointment and reserve a table in advance.
promotionDetail.terms: Advance booking required, not applicable on major holidays.

promotionDetail.title: Complete Family Happiness Vacation
promotionDetail.description: Free stay for children under 12, including tickets to the hotel's private play area.
promotionDetail.full_description:
Your family vacation will be even more memorable with this offer. The package includes: Free stay for 2 children under 12 when sharing a room with parents in a Suite or Executive Suite, free entry to the Kid's Club throughout the stay, and a complimentary family pizza lunch at the Pool Bar.

Applicable for bookings from now until September 30, 2025. Please present the children's identification upon check-in.
promotionDetail.terms: Applicable for children under 12, maximum 2 children per room.

promotionDetail.title: Early Bird Offer - Maximum Savings
promotionDetail.description: Book 30 days in advance to receive up to 15% off on all room types.
promotionDetail.full_description:
Plan your trip early to get the best deals. Get a 15% discount for bookings made 30 days before the check-in date, and a 10% discount for bookings made 15 days in advance. Applicable to all room types and not limited by length of stay.

This promotion cannot be combined with other offers. Free cancellation is available up to 7 days before the check-in date.
promotionDetail.terms: Must book by the specified number of days in advance to receive the offer.
